1. Pairing: Press power button for 3 seconds until blue light blinks, then select "Portable Bluetooth Speaker" in your device's Bluetooth menu.

If you have any issues with pairing, just reply to this email or call 1-800-TECHMART.

Enjoy your new speaker!

Best,
TechMart Support
